one_line: Persian-born vizier of the Bahmani Sultanate who expanded its Deccan power and founded the great madrasa of Bidar.

appearance.age_look: Late 40s to early 50s, tall and lean with a scholar-official’s posture.
appearance.face: Oval face with a calm, thoughtful expression; wheatish-light brown complexion; sharp nose, neatly trimmed medium-length salt-and-pepper beard with a narrow moustache; slightly arched brows and large, focused anime-style eyes that soften when he smiles.
appearance.hair: Dark hair just visible at the temples under a tall, slightly conical dark green quilted turban wrapped with a cream band, the turban front adorned with a small, simple gold crescent-shaped brooch.
appearance.costume: A long, ankle-length Persian-style robe (qabā) of deep emerald green silk with subtle vertical woven patterns, worn over a cream cotton under-tunic; the robe has long, slightly flared sleeves and a front opening secured with small fabric toggles, its edges and cuffs trimmed with a narrow band of indigo and gold geometric braid; around his waist a broad maroon cloth belt (patka) with a faint floral motif is neatly wrapped and knotted to one side; loose cream trousers gather at the ankles into simple brown leather shoes with slightly upturned toes; over one shoulder he sometimes wears a light indigo shawl with simple block-printed borders, hinting at Deccan textile styles but kept elegant and understated.
appearance.signature: A rolled parchment land-survey scroll bound with a maroon ribbon, tucked into his belt on the left side, with a wooden writing board and reed pen case peeking from behind it.

ref_desc: Mahmud Gawan is a tall, lean man in his late 40s with a wheatish-light brown oval face, salt-and-pepper beard, dark green quilted turban with a cream band and gold crescent brooch, wearing an emerald green Persian-style robe over cream garments with maroon belt and brown shoes, carrying a rolled parchment land-survey scroll at his waist with indigo and gold accents throughout.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Mahmud Gawan, a tall, lean man in his late 40s with a wheatish-light brown oval face, sharp nose, neatly trimmed salt-and-pepper beard and narrow moustache, and large focused eyes with a calm, thoughtful default expression; his dark hair is mostly hidden under a tall, slightly conical dark green quilted turban wrapped with a cream band, the front set with a small gold crescent-shaped brooch. He wears an ankle-length emerald green Persian-style robe (qabā) of fine silk with subtle vertical weave, long slightly flared sleeves, and a front opening closed with small fabric toggles, its edges and cuffs finished with a narrow indigo and gold geometric braid. Under it, show a simple cream cotton tunic and loose cream trousers gathered at the ankles, going into brown leather shoes with slightly upturned toes. Around his waist is a broad maroon cloth belt (patka) with a faint floral motif, neatly wrapped and knotted slightly to one side, and over one shoulder a light indigo shawl with understated printed borders drapes softly without obscuring the robe design. His signature prop is a rolled parchment land-survey scroll bound with a maroon ribbon, tucked into his belt on the left, with the ends of a small wooden writing board and a reed pen case visible behind it. Emphasize consistent emerald green, cream, indigo, maroon and brown colours, clear view of face, turban, full costume head to toe, and the scroll as his defining accessory, in a clean neutral background suitable for reuse in many panels.
